mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate, as observed in the most recent monthly data, compresses the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% (as measured in the most recent monthly data) indicates deteriorating labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% (as of the decision point), or the Rank IC between UNRATE (exceeding 5.0%) and 20-day returns is above 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in manufacturing employment (PAYEMS) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between the interaction term (PAYEMS growth * INDPRO growth) and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of housing market recovery (HOUST above 2000 thousand units), increased residential construction activity signals stronger consumer confidence and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 2000 (as of the decision point), or the Rank IC between HOUST (above 2000) and 20-day returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index value above 199.5 (as of the decision point) indicates elevated inflation pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which depresses equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 199.5 (as of the decision point), or the Rank IC between CPIAUCSL (exceeding 199.5) and 20-day returns is above 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer and housing demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between the interaction term (RSAFS growth * HOUST growth) and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% (as measured in the most recent monthly data) signals imminent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% (as of the decision point), or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS (exceeding 4.5%) and 5-day returns is above 0.03.
